checks_run.procedure: D-216 open question on BE-Z8: does reading the stored column under the advisory lock and FOR UPDATE keep the intent of the 0101 guard, with no lost or double-counted occurrence? I read raiseOperationalException (exceptions.ts 710-790), raiseOperationalExceptionTwin (kit.ts), the 0101 guard (lines 191-219) and BE-Z8's raiser table, then ran the probe of QA-R6-VERIF.
checks_run.command: git diff d7b21bad..031945d8 -- apps/api/src/modules/operations/exceptions.ts apps/worker/src/kit.ts; probe as QA-R6-VERIF
checks_run.environment: Clone m; disposable PostgreSQL 16.15
checks_run.expected: No backwards move, exactly one occurrence per raise, the guard unchanged
checks_run.actual: Yes. The raise takes the advisory lock per (organization, dedup key), then SELECT ... FOR UPDATE of the active row (READ COMMITTED), then UPDATE ... WHERE version = current.version. greatest(now(), operational_exception.last_occurred_at) uses that locked row's own microsecond value (OLD), so NEW >= OLD always holds. occurrence_count is current + 1 from the same locked read, so the guard's 'count steps by exactly one' still rejects a double count; nothing was relaxed, retried or upserted. My probe confirms both properties under concurrency: occurrences equal captures and recurred events equal captures - 1, in 60 bursts and 5 API rounds, with exactly one open exception each time (no duplicate open). The job-level ledger (processed_message queue:jobId) still stops a replayed job from counting twice. No other monotonic timestamp is written from a JavaScript value (grep for ${...}::timestamptz in apps/*/src: only cursor bounds and business-date inputs).

checks_run.procedure: D-216 open question on BE-Z7B's declared residuals (handback §7), judged against ADR-0051 §2 and its 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-06 amendments and D-195 Q3. I read restricted.ts (dashboards and reports), recordRefSensitivity, executive-overview.ts, reports/ui.tsx and the new tests, and took the sweep's list of unfillable operations from integration run 1. For item 4 I wrote and ran a real-stack probe on the demo database (zz-qa-dg6r6-restricted-label-ui): the TO marks demo benefit B01 sensitive; the TL (not admitted) and the TO open the Executive Overview and the live benefits register preview; the probe compares the API and the screen.

checks_run.environment: Demo-initialized stack; chromium-en and chromium-ar; ports 30362/30364; screenshots to the evidence directory
checks_run.expected: Each residual is acceptable under ADR-0051, or raised as a finding
checks_run.actual: (1) The 75 unfillable GETs are acceptable. The list is logged by name. The benefit-named ones (getBenefitGroup, getBenefitOverlap, getBenefitScenario, getTransitionDecision) were judged in round 5: path-guarded, or presenting ids only. getWorkstreamDashboard is covered by the new synthetic-workstream test. The three newly unfillable ones (getInitiativeSchedule, getMeetingMinutes, getMeetingCutoffPack) hold no benefit value (cut-off.ts has no benefit reference), and getOwnerUpdate's subjects are transformations and workstreams. (2) The search index is acceptable: search applies readScopeFor (search/query.ts), and search-parity.test.ts and a12 test sensitive search; both pass. (3) The flag-only adoption filter is acceptable: adoption items are KPIs, never sensitive types or their children, and the ADR records that a change must add the member. (4) The omitted-table totals are NOT acceptable. On the real stack the API is right: section totals_sar_revenue_uplift gives the TL 0 rows (the TO 1), the same totals as the TO (SAR 222,750 validated, SAR 99,000 pending) and includesRestrictedRecords true. The screen is not: the TL sees 'Revenue uplift', 'Includes restricted records' and 'No records' / 'لا توجد سجلات', and no Total row. The TL sees 2 totals rows, the TO 3, and the TL's own preview before the marking showed 3. That contradicts ADR-0051 §2 ('the table totals and metrics of every report section' are the same for every reader) and D-195 Q3, and it is raised as F-DG6-440 (Medium). The rest of the probe passes: the overview shows the label to the TL and not to the TO, the benefit id never reaches the TL's DOM, the TL gets no row of B01 and sees the label, and the TO sees the row and no label. The probe exits 1 because of the finding's assertion.
